title: POWERFUL PRAYERS TO COMMAND THE FIRST MONDAY OF THE NEW MONTH
text: There is something happening in the realm of the spirit right now in this very hour, and I need somebody reading this, somebody standing where you are, sitting where you are, to lift your two hands and say to the Father, I am ready. Not ready in the flesh, ready in the spirit. Because what we are about to do is not ordinary. We're not just starting a new week. We're not just turning a calendar page. Something is being loose over the gates of this month, and the first Monday, the first Monday is the hinge on which the rest of these 30 days will swing. Somebody shout it with me before we even go further. This month is mine. I sense in my spirit that some of you carried last month like a wound. Something did not go the way you labored for it to go. A door shuts that you thought was already open. A voice spoke against you that you did not even hear with your natural ears, but your spirit felt the weight of it. Some of you are entering this month tired, not lazy, tired, worrying tired. Believing tired. And the enemy is counting on your tiredness to make you skip the one appointment heaven has set for you, the appointment of the first Monday. Let me tell you something the word settles before we lift another word in prayer. Psalm 118:24 says, "This is the day which the Lord hath made. We will rejoice and be glad in it." Notice it does not say, "This is the day man planned." It says, "This is the day the Lord has made." Which means before your enemy scheduled his attack, before the strategy of hell was drawn up against your finances, your marriage, your children, your health, God had already made this day. Which means whatever he made, he made with a purpose. And whatever he made with purpose, he's not going to abandon to accident. I want you to understand something about the first Monday of a new month that most believers walk past without discernment. In the spirit realm, time is not neutral. Time is territory. Ecclesiastes 3:1 tells us there is a time to every purpose under heaven, meaning purposes are assigned to times, and times carry purposes the way a womb carries a child. If you do not possess the time, the time will be possessed by whoever is aggressive enough to take it. The first Monday of the month is a gate. Gates are contested. Whoever controls the gate controls what flows in and what is kept out. >> [music] >> So, this is not a soft devotional moment. This is war. Turn to somebody if you can or lift your voice right where you are and say, "I refuse to enter this month the way the enemy designed it. I enter it the way my father designed it." Come on, let's begin to travail. Let your spirit rise. Let something in you that has been sitting down begin to stand. Let something in you that has been silent begin to speak. Ashe. Rara koye. Shall ahama. Eloi rasha koham. Let the fire fall on your tongue. Let the language of the spirit take over where your understanding runs dry because there are some battles your mother tongue was never built to fight. I hear the spirit saying, "I am not visiting you today. I am invading you today." Somebody receive that. Not a visitation, an invasion. Because a visitor knocks and waits to be let in, but on this first Monday, the spirit of the living God is not asking for permission to move on your behalf. He's moving because the blood of Jesus has already given him legal ground in your life. Now, let us build understanding before we build fire because revelation must always come before demonstration. In the book of Nehemiah, when the wall was to be rebuilt, Nehemiah did not just show up and start crying and shouting. He surveyed the wall first by night, quietly, before he told anybody what God had put in his heart. Nehemiah 2:12 says, he told no man what God had put in his heart to do. There is a lesson buried in there for us as we command this month. Some of your prayer requests are too sacred to be announced before they are answered. Some things you carry into this first Monday must be carried in secret travail before they become public testimony. But there is something else Nehemiah shows us. He assessed the brokenness before he began to rebuild. Beloved, before you can command the month, you must be honest about what is broken. Is it your finances that are broken? Is it your health? Is it the walls of your marriage that have cracks nobody sees but you feel every night? Is it your children wandering and you don't know which door they walk through? Whatever is broken, name it now. Not to me, not to any man, name it to God silently in your spirit right now. I feel something rising. There is a woman reading this who has been carrying a report from the hospital that she has refused to accept as final. I speak to that report right now. By the stripes of Jesus, you are overruled. Isaiah 53:5 declares that by his stripes we are healed. Not we shall be healed one day when we feel like it, but we are healed. Past tense, settled in eternity, present tense working in your body right now. Receive it. Don't just read it, receive it into your bones, into your bloodstream, into every organ the enemy has laid ambush against. There is a man reading this whose business has been standing still like water that refuses to flow, like a river dammed by an unseen hand. I speak to every dam erected over your finances in the spirit realm. In the name of Jesus, break now. Let the water flow. Let the increase you have been laboring for since the beginning of this year locate you before this month is finished. Somebody say it with everything in you. I am not negotiating with delay. Delay, your time is up. Now, hold that fire because I want to take you deeper into why the first Monday matters so much in the calendar of the spirit. In the Old Testament, the children of Israel were commanded to observe the new moon. Numbers 10:10 speaks of the beginning of months and how trumpets were to be blown over burnt offerings and peace offerings that they may be to Israel for a memorial before their God. Did you hear that? A memorial before God. Meaning when Israel blew the trumpet at the beginning of the month, it was not for man to hear. It was a legal declaration in the courts of heaven that said, "Remember your covenant, oh God, at the entrance of this new season." That is exactly what we are doing right now. We are not shouting for men to hear us. We are blowing the trumpet of our mouth so that heaven's record book opens to a fresh page with our name already written in the margin of mercy. Let the trumpet sound in the spirit. Let every angel assigned to your file wake up right now. Psalm 103:20 says, "Bless the Lord, ye his angels that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word." Angels respond to the voice of the word, not the voice of complaint, not the voice of fear, but the word of the word spoken in faith. So, when you pray this month, don't pray like a beggar. Pray like an heir reading out the terms of a will that has already been signed in blood. I decree over you, let the angels of your breakthrough be dispatched now. In the name of Jesus, I decree, let every messenger of darkness sent to intercept your miracle be arrested at the border. I decree whatever was stolen from you in the last quarter of this year, let it be restored sevenfold according to Proverbs 6:31. Somebody shout restoration. Say it like you mean it. Say it like your children are watching you. Say it because they have a pound. Say it like your future self will remember this moment as the day the tide turned. Now, let's go into deep waters because I sense there are people who have been fighting battles that did not start with them. Some of you were born into a family where poverty is treated like an inheritance, where sickness is treated like a family tradition, where marriages break like it is written into the blood. >> [music] >> I want you to know something. Those are not just natural patterns. Some of those are covenant assignments from evil altars that your forefathers knowingly or unknowingly bowed before. Exodus 20:5 speaks of iniquity being visited onto the third and fourth generation of them that hate God, but hallelujah, Galatians 3:13 declares that Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us. So, on this first Monday, we're not just praying weak prayers of please God help me. We're pulling down altars. We are dismantling covenants our mouths never signed, but our blood has been paying tribute to. Let the fire fall. A caution ambraya and shelly kotoba ranga eloy shakame. Let every hidden altar feeding on the destiny of this household be located and set ablaze by the fire of the Holy Ghost. I speak over every ancestral altar assigned against your bloodline. By the blood of Jesus, you are disconnected from my family today. I speak over every covenant of poverty signed in darkness before you were born. Let it be turned like a certificate in the hand of fire. I speak over every marital pattern of separation and divorce that has followed your bloodline. It stops with me. It stops here. Somebody breathe. Let's slow down and let the word settle in your spirit before we rise again in prayer. Because fire without foundation burns out fast, but fire built on the word burns like Elijah's altar. Even the water cannot quench it. Turn with me to 1 Chronicles 12:32. The children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times to know what Israel ought to do. This is the spirit we need entering this first Monday. Not just zeal understanding. Issachar did not just feel the times. They understood the times and because they understood, they knew what to do. Many believers feel that something is shifting in the spirit realm, but they do not know what to do with the shift. So, the shift passes them by like wind passing an closed window. I pray for you now. Let understanding be given to you like it was given to the sons of Issachar that you may know exactly what this father is doing in this new month and align your steps accordingly. There is a reason the enemy fights the beginning of things more than the middle. Whoever controls the beginning shapes the direction of the whole journey. That is why Pharaoh targeted the baby boys of Israel at birth. Exodus 1:22. Not at their strength, but at their beginning because he understood that if he could kill the beginning, he would never have to fight the destiny that beginning was carrying. The enemy is doing the same thing with your month. He's not necessarily coming for you on the 20th. He's coming for you on the first Monday because he knows that if he can hijack your beginning, he can quietly reroute your whole 30 days without you even noticing until it's too late. So, we do not take the first Monday lightly. We rise on it like Israel rose with trumpets. We consecrate on it like Joshua consecrated the people before crossing Jordan. Joshua 3:5, "Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow the Lord will do wonders among you. Sanctify yourself today." Put away every unforgiveness. Put away every bitterness. Put away every secret compromise because you cannot carry unclean hands into a month that God has assigned wonders to. Let's pray. Let's really pray now. Not the prayer of formality, the prayer that shakes principalities. Father, in the name of Jesus, we thank you for the gift of another month. We thank you that our names are still written among the living, that our breath did not stop before we could see this day. We do not take this for granted, Father. Some slept last night and did not wake, but you woke us. So, first, before we ask you for anything, we thank you. Now, Father, we come before you as Nehemiah came before the broken wall. We are honest with you about what is broken in our lives. Where marriages are cracked, mend them in the name of Jesus. Where finances are frozen, thaw them by fire in the name of Jesus. Where bodies are afflicted, heal them according to your stripes in the name of Jesus. Where destinies have been buried under family patterns of failure, exhume them and resurrect them in the name of Jesus. I command every gate assigned to this month to open in the direction of my breakthrough. I command every altar assigned to close doors against me to be shut down permanently. [music] I command the trumpet of heaven to sound over my life that heaven's record may open a new page over my name. Somebody say I receive my month back from the hand of the enemy. Let's go into another dimension now because I sense there's a company of people here who need deliverance for their family, not just for themselves, but for the people connected to them by blood and by covenant. You can be blessed and still watching your household bleed. You can be strong and still carrying weak ones on your shoulders. God is not just interested in your personal breakthrough this month. He wants your household breakthrough, too. Joshua 24:15 says, "As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord." Notice Joshua did not say as for me alone. He carried his household into his covenant declaration. That is what we are doing now. Whatever God is doing for you this first Monday, carry your household into it by faith. Is there a prodigal child somewhere reading this on behalf of a mother who cannot sleep at night because her son has wandered far? I speak to that wandering son or daughter right now, wherever they are, by the same power that brought the prodigal son to himself in Luke 15:17, I command you to come to yourself this month. Let the famine of the far country begin to bite them until they remember their father's house. Is there a husband and wife somewhere on the brink, sleeping in the same bed but living like strangers, saying good morning out of duty and not out of love anymore? I speak resurrection over that marriage. Ezekiel 37:5 says, "Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live. Let breath reenter that marriage. Let the years the locusts has eaten in that home be restored, according to Joel 2:25." Declare with me, "My marriage will not become a statistic. My home will not become a casualty of this season. Let the fire fall again. Kilombasha ran ye. Ashoto kalabani rakosham alloy. Let every spirit of strife assigned to homes be scattered by the thunder of God's presence. I decree every marriage under attack this month shall experience divine intervention. I decree every child far from God shall be arrested by grace before this month ends. I decree every home marked out for separation shall instead be marked out for restoration. There is something on my spirit about time itself, about the years and the seasons that have been stolen. Some of you have been in a wilderness season so long you have forgotten what a harvest season feels like. I want to remind you of Joel 2:25 again because it bears repeating in a piece like this. And I will restore to you the years that the locusts have eaten. God is not just a healer of moments. He's a restorer of years. That means the delay is not the final chapter. That means the years the enemy chewed up in your 20s can still be repaid to you in your 30s, your 40s, your 50s. Time is not a linear prison to God. He owns eternity and he can fold time back on itself to give you what was taken. Somebody shout my years are coming back. Let's pray now for financial gates because I know money is not the whole of life, but I also know that lack has buried destinies [music and singing] that gold could have lifted. Malachi 3:10 says, "Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse and prove me now here with said the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it." This first Monday, I'm not asking you to just believe for a small blessing. I am asking you to position yourself for a blessing so large that your bands cannot contain it, your bank account cannot process it fast enough, your accountant will be confused by the pace of your increase. Father, in the name of Jesus, we thank you for opening the windows of heaven over your children. Let every financial gate assigned to open this month open now. Let every contract that has been signed be let every salary increment that has been pending be approved. Let every business deal that has stalled for months move again. Like Ezekiel's value of dry bones, Ezekiel 37:10, when breath came into them and they stood upon their feet an exceedingly great army. I speak to every dry financial situation, life, stand up, become an exceedingly great army of increase in my life. Somebody say it with your whole chest, my money is coming back to life this month. Now, I want to shift the atmosphere because there is a warfare dimension we cannot skip when we talk about commanding a month. Ephesians 6:12 tells us plainly, for we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. This means the resistance you have been facing was never really about your boss, your neighbor, your in-law, your ex. Those are just faces. Behind those faces are principalities assigned to frustrate the plan of God over your life. So, on this first Monday, we are not fighting people, we are dismantling thrones. Let the anointing rise. Let the fire increase. Esha Koroba Enteli Washaya Rakombeli Asha. Let every witchcraft gathering that convened against this household in the past week be scattered like chaff before the wind, according to Psalm 1:4. I decree every coven that sat down to plan against my month, your meeting is declared illegal in the courts of heaven. I decree every witchcraft arrow fired against my destiny in the night return to sender by fire. I decree whatever has eaten my flesh in the dream, like the psalmist described in Psalm 27:2, let them stumble and fall. Somebody stand up in your spirit right now, even if your body is seated, and say I am not a victim, I am a victor in Christ Jesus. Let me minister something else. The spirit is highlighting divine preservation. This world has become increasingly unpredictable, and I sense there are people who need, not just breakthrough this month, but protection. Psalm 91:10 says, "There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling." I speak divine preservation over your body, your family, your vehicle, your business premises, your finances, your relationships. Whatever tries to come close to your dwelling with evil intent, let it be repelled by the fire of God's covering. Father, we ask for traveling mercies over every road your children shall travel this month. We ask for divine protection over every flight, every journey, every commute. Let no accident locate any reader of this prayer. Let no strange sickness locate their household. Let the blood of Jesus be a covering over every doorpost, the way it was over Israel in Egypt in Exodus 12:13, so that the destroyer, when he passes through the land, will pass over every house marked by the blood. I decree the blood of Jesus is upon my doorpost. The destroyer has no access to my dwelling this month. Let's return to declarations because I feel the tempo of the spirit rising again. Somebody, wherever you are, lift your voice and let these declarations leave your mouth like coals of fire. I decree that my destiny buried by circumstance shall be exhumed and celebrated this month. I decree that every table prepared in my [music] presence by my enemies, according to Psalm 23:5, it shall become a platform for my testimony. I decree that whatever the enemy meant for evil against me, God shall mean it for good, according to Genesis 50:20. I decree that my virtue, my strength, my vitality, my joy, my peace of mind stolen by years of struggle is restored to me today. I decree that my name shall not be found on the list of those who missed their moment. Come on, let's push further into the prayer realm because I still feel unfinished business in the spirit. There is a category of people here who have been believing for children. The fruit of the womb has tarried and every month feels like another delay stacked on top of a mountain of delays. I speak to every closed womb. Genesis 30:22 says, "And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb." Let God remember you the way he remembered Rachel. Let every medical explanation bow to the God who opens wombs by his word alone. I decree over every womb assigned to carry a miracle this year, open now in the name of Jesus. I decree over every family waiting for a testimony of child birth. Your waiting ends in testimony, not in silence. There is also someone here believing for a job and every application has returned rejection. Every interview has ended in silence and the silence itself has become louder than any no would have been. I speak to that silence. Isaiah 45:2 says, "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. Let every crooked interview process be made straight." Let every closed door marked not qualified swing open because heaven has qualified you where man disqualified you. Somebody declare, "My qualification is not in my certificate alone, it is in the favor of my God." Let's minister prophetically for a moment because I sense the Holy Spirit wants to speak directly, not just through teaching, but through a living word for somebody reading this right now. The Spirit says, >> [music] >> "There is one among you who has been asking me for a sign that I am still with you. I say to you the very fact that you are still standing after what you walked through last month is your sign. I did not leave you. I carried you through what should have broken you and I am not going to abandon you at the threshold of your breakthrough. The Spirit says, "There is one among you who planned to give up this month, not on life, but on a dream, on a vision, on a business, on a marriage, on a ministry. I say to you, do not sign the papers of surrender. The delay you are experiencing is not a rejection, it is a repositioning. What looks like a setback is actually a setup for a greater comeback. The Spirit says, "There is a mother reading this who has cried more tears in secret than her children have ever seen on her face. I see those tears." Psalm 56:8 says, "I put your tears into my bottle. Not one drop was wasted. Every tear you cried is being converted into oil for your future testimony." Let's respond to that word in prayer. Father, we receive every word spoken over your people today. Let it not return void, according to Isaiah 55:11. "So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth. It shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please." Let this word [music] accomplish everything you have purposed by it. Now, let's build momentum again for a final push into deep intercession because I believe there is grace for one more wave of warfare before we settle into declarations of gratitude and rest. Somebody tighten your spirit. Let's go after the enemy's camp directly. 2 Corinthians 10:4 tells us that the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds. This is not a metaphorical statement. It is a legal and spiritual reality. Whatever stronghold has held your life captive, a stronghold of fear, a stronghold of poverty, a stronghold of sickness, a stronghold of shame is being pulled down right now as you pray with me. Let the fire fall. Ashakolindi, bereshan nyoto kalam, eloi rasha kondobi. Let every stronghold built by generational sin, personal disobedience, or demonic assignment be pulled down to its foundation and salted so it cannot be rebuilt. I decree every stronghold of fear in my mind, you are pulled down now. I decree every stronghold of poverty in my family line, >> [music] >> you are pulled down now. I decree every stronghold of shame from things done to me or by me, you are pulled down now. Because Romans 8:1 says, "There is no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus." Somebody shout, "I am free." Not because I feel free, because the son has made me free. And John 8:36 says, "Whom the son sets free is free indeed." Let's minister on health and healing a little more deeply, because bodies are groaning under the weight of diagnosis this season. James 5:14-15 tells us, "Is any sick among you? Let him call for the elders of the church, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord. And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up." I stand in that place of intercession now for every sick body reading or hearing this word. Father, in the name of Jesus, we call forth healing over every organ under attack. We call forth healing over every diagnosis that has frightened your children into sleepless nights. We speak to cancer cells, die in the name of Jesus. We speak to high blood pressure, normalize in the name of Jesus. We speak to unexplained pain, leave in the name of Jesus. We speak to every infirmity that has bowed a body for years, the way the woman was bowed for 18 years in Luke 13:11, Jesus called her, loosed her, and she was made straight immediately. We call that same immediate healing now. Somebody declare, "My body is the temple of the Holy Ghost, and no sickness has a legal right to operate in this temple." Let's turn now to a place of thanksgiving, because after warfare must come worship you. Do not leave the battlefield without acknowledging the commander who fought for you. Psalm 100:4 says, "Enter into his gates with Thanksgiving and into his courts with praise. Be thankful unto him and bless his name. As we begin to draw toward the end of this ministration, let your heart shift from asking to thanking. Father, we thank you for hearing every prayer prayed in this piece. We thank you that you are not a God who ignores the cry of your children. We thank you that the first Monday of this month is not just a date on a calendar, but a divine appointment you set before the foundation of the world. We thank you for grace to see this day and grace to see the fulfillment of every word spoken. But before we close, let me speak a few more prophetic utterances over specific situations because I sense the spirit is not finished ministering individually to people reading this. There is someone who has been praying for a specific number, a specific amount of money for a specific need and has grown weary of naming it before God because it feels impossible. I say to you, name it again. Don't let weariness silence your specific request. Mark 11 verse 24 says, "What things soever you desire when you pray, believe that you receive them and you shall have them." Name your number again this first Monday. Heaven is not tired of hearing it. There is someone who lost a loved one and has been grieving quietly while everyone assumes you have moved on. I speak comfort over you right now. Matthew 5 verse 4 says, "Blessed are they that mourn, for they shall be comforted." Let comfort locate you today in a way that surprises you, not because the pain fully disappears, but because the weight of it becomes bearable by grace you did not know you had access to. There is someone whose reputation was destroyed by lies and you have [music] carried the shame of accusations that were never true. I speak vindication over you. Isaiah 54:17 says, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shall condemn. Let every false tongue be silenced." Let your true character be revealed to the very people who doubted you. Somebody shout, "Vindication is my portion this month." Let's go into one final wave of declarations before we close in prayer, because I believe by now the atmosphere is thick with the presence of God, and I don't want to leave a single assignment untouched. I decree, whatever died in me last month, let it resurrect this month. According to Romans 8:11, the spirit that raised Christ from the dead dwells in me. I decree, every seed I have sown in faith, let it now germinate and bear fruit. I decree, every assignment of delay over my family is terminated from this first Monday going forward. I decree, my testimony this month shall be so loud that it becomes someone else's faith to believe God again. I decree, heaven's calendar and my calendar are now aligned. What God has scheduled for me, no devil can reschedule. Let us pray one final focused prayer of consecration and commissioning as we release this month into the hands of God. Father, in the name of Jesus, we present ourselves to you as living sacrifices according to Romans 12:1, holy and acceptable, which is our reasonable service. We do not just want a good month, we want a month that glorifies you. We do not just want breakthrough, we want a testimony that points people back to your faithfulness. Let this first Monday be a marker in our lives, a day we look back on and say that was when everything changed. We commit our finances into your hands, multiply them. We commit our marriages into your hands, heal them. We commit our children into your hands, save them. We commit our health into your hands, restore it. We commit our destinies into your hands, fulfill them. We commit our time into your hands, redeem it. In the mighty name of Jesus we have prayed, we have declared, we have decreed, and we believe it is already settled in the courts of heaven. As it is written, so let it be done. As it is spoken, so let it be established. Somebody shout your loudest amen, not the church amen. The amen that comes from the pit of your stomach. The amen that agrees with everything heaven has just released over your life. This month is yours. Walk into it like a child of the king, because that is exactly what you are. Go in fire, go in faith, go in victory that has already been secured by the finished work of the cross. The first Monday has been commanded, the rest of the month must now bow to what has been decreed. It is settled, [music] it is sealed, it is yours in the mighty, matchless, unshakable name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Amen. And amen.
